terminologyRules: Crystalluria, a urolith and urinary obstruction are separate authored entities.
Urine pH, crystal morphology, radiopacity, breed or visual appearance never confirm quantitative stone composition alone.
LUTS and FLUTD describe signs or an umbrella category and are not etiologic diagnoses.
Actual urine output and bladder status precede detailed diet or mineral discussion.
Normal urination and a nondistended bladder do not exclude unilateral ureteral obstruction.
An obstructed patient is not a routine dissolution candidate until outflow and systemic risk are safely addressed.
Stone size, number, location, serial trajectory and episode time persist through reload and cannot adapt to player choices.
Drug, dose, diet formula, urinary target and catheter, lithotripsy, stent, SUB or surgical technique require separately approved protocols.

variants.title: Струвитный уролит — кандидат на растворение
variants.diagnosticTruth: Stable nonobstructed patient has location, imaging and species-specific urine/culture evidence compatible with a reviewed dissolution route.

presentations.complaint: У собаки radiopaque bladder stones и culture/urine pattern совместимы с infection-induced struvite.

historyAnswers.actual_urine_output: Passing urine or obstruction route first.

followUp.timing: culture and protocol-defined serial imaging checkpoints

outcomes.safe: Infection and dissolution response are measured together.
outcomes.unsafe: pH or crystals trigger diet/antimicrobial automatically.

ownerCommunication: Explain why culture response and repeat images are both required.

presentations.complaint: У не-obstructed кошки imaging/urine pattern совместим со sterile struvite без доказанной инфекции.

followUp.timing: early intake/output check and scheduled same-method imaging

outcomes.safe: Feline sterile pattern is monitored without unnecessary antibiotics.
outcomes.unsafe: Canine infection logic or crystals alone determine therapy.

ownerCommunication: List every food access and emergency no-output signs.

presentations.complaint: Same-method imaging показывает shrinkage, отсутствие изменения или рост по заранее заданной trajectory.

followUp.timing: continue, reclassify or intervene at authored checkpoint

outcomes.unsafe: Waiting continues despite growth or reload changes outcome.

ownerCommunication: Explain what the image proves and the hard reasons to stop waiting.

variants.title: Нерастворимый уролит нижних мочевых путей
variants.diagnosticTruth: Composition/pattern is not safely dissolvable or anatomy/patient risk supports removal or monitored retention rather than blind dissolution.

presentations.complaint: Radiopaque bladder stone pattern совместим с calcium oxalate, но требует retrieval и quantitative analysis.

outcomes.safe: Least-invasive appropriate route followed by analysis.
outcomes.unsafe: Acidification or dissolution is generated universally.

presentations.complaint: Radiolucent/variable stone и breed/hepatic/metabolic context raises urate or cystine concern.

outcomes.safe: Risk clues direct testing without naming composition.
outcomes.unsafe: Breed or pH selects a diet/drug plan.

ownerCommunication: Explain why the underlying systemic cause matters as much as removal.

presentations.complaint: Incidental lower-tract stone is asymptomatic; passage/obstruction risk is authored low or material.

outcomes.safe: Low-risk monitoring is clinically and economically valid.

ownerCommunication: Explain both obstruction warning signs and the next measurement date.

variants.title: Уретральная обструкция камнем, пробкой или стриктурой
variants.diagnosticTruth: Urine outflow is mechanically or functionally blocked; cause is classified after immediate perfusion, renal, potassium, acid-base and rhythm risk.

presentations.complaint: Кот многократно тужится без подтверждённой мочи; владелец может считать это запором.

examFindings.finding: Large painful bladder supports emergency route.

followUp.timing: continuous through relief and postobstructive monitoring

outcomes.safe: Emergency obstruction is recognized before etiologic detail.
outcomes.unsafe: Constipation or routine dissolution delays outflow relief.

ownerCommunication: Explain that no urine is immediately life-threatening and not a constipation wait-and-see problem.

presentations.complaint: У собаки partial/complete urethral obstruction с stone, mass, prostate или stricture differential.

outcomes.safe: Outflow restored and cause remains differentiated.
outcomes.unsafe: UI chooses direct surgery or assumes every obstruction is a stone.

ownerCommunication: Explain immediate relief versus later cause confirmation.

presentations.complaint: Recurrent obstruction после предыдущего catheter/procedure; stone, plug, inflammation, stricture и environment remain classified.

examFindings.finding: Prior success does not reduce current risk.

followUp.timing: emergency relief then versioned recurrence plan

outcomes.safe: Reobstruction is treated urgently and salvage expectations are realistic.
outcomes.unsafe: Previous surgery guarantees cure or episode becomes a new patient.

ownerCommunication: Explain current emergency and what salvage can and cannot prevent.

variants.title: Нефролит или уретеролит
variants.diagnosticTruth: Nephrolith/ureterolith may be incidental or obstructive; both kidneys, ureters, renal function and contralateral reserve determine urgency.

presentations.complaint: Incidental nephrolith без pelvic/ureter dilation, pain, infection или renal-function decline.

examFindings.finding: Monitoring may preserve function with less harm.
Serial function and anatomy are required.

followUp.timing: scheduled renal function and same-method ultrasound

outcomes.safe: Selected incidental nephrolith is monitored objectively.
outcomes.unsafe: Presence alone triggers invasive removal or CKD attribution.

ownerCommunication: Explain why monitoring can be safer and which findings change the plan.

presentations.complaint: Mild vomiting/lethargy/renal pain при normal urination и nondistended bladder; unilateral ureter obstruction suspected.

examFindings.finding: Imaging and serial pelvis/function drive diagnosis.

followUp.timing: urgent specialist and serial pelvis/function checks

outcomes.safe: Subtle unilateral disease is detected despite normal urine output.
outcomes.unsafe: Normal output or modest creatinine dismisses obstruction.

ownerCommunication: Explain how the other kidney can hide loss of function on one side.

presentations.complaint: Bilateral obstruction либо unilateral obstruction при CKD/single kidney вызывает azotemia, oliguria/anuria или systemic decline.

examFindings.finding: Renal/electrolyte stabilization and referral proceed together.
Experienced specialist uses anatomy and resources.

followUp.timing: continuous through intervention and postobstructive phase

outcomes.safe: Limited renal reserve triggers emergency specialist care.
outcomes.unsafe: UI chooses device or routine monitoring delays relief.

ownerCommunication: Explain immediate kidney/electrolyte risk and specialist-dependent options.

variants.title: Рецидивирующий уролитиаз и контроль после удаления
variants.diagnosticTruth: Removal or dissolution is incomplete as a disease plan until quantitative composition, clearance and underlying infection/metabolic/diet-water factors are addressed longitudinally.

presentations.complaint: Quantitative report lists mineral components/proportions and changes prevention compared with visual suspicion.

followUp.timing: analysis review then type-specific serial plan

outcomes.unsafe: Color, pH or one crystal creates a generic diet.

ownerCommunication: Explain why removal solves blockage but not the reason stones formed.

presentations.complaint: Postprocedure imaging показывает residual fragment/material несмотря на symptom improvement.

examFindings.finding: Further retrieval versus monitoring is specialist-reviewed.

outcomes.safe: Residual burden remains visible and routed proportionately.

ownerCommunication: Explain what remains and why it may be monitored or retrieved.

presentations.complaint: Stone recurs despite reported diet or infection control; wrong type, residual stone, reinfection and metabolic driver remain possible.

examFindings.finding: Composition and driver determine revised plan.

followUp.timing: cause audit then revised versioned checkpoints

outcomes.safe: Recurrence is explained before the plan changes.
outcomes.unsafe: Owner is blamed or diets are switched randomly.

ownerCommunication: Review barriers without blame and explain which evidence changes prevention.

familyValidationRules: Reject if urine-flow obstruction and systemic instability are not assessed before stone composition planning.
Reject if crystals, pH, breed or visual appearance alone define urolith composition.
Reject if canine infection-associated logic is copied to feline struvite disease.
Reject if a nondissolvable stone receives a dissolution promise or instant clearance.
Reject if unilateral upper-tract disease is dismissed by one creatinine value or a nondistended bladder.
Reject if the generator creates a diet formula, drug, dose, catheter, stent, SUB or surgical technique.
